Hi Lucas — thanks for the sample, that helps. High-level guidance below; I've also attached a PO activation template and a short CUIT validation note for your team.

Key mapping checklist for PO auto-activation (minimum fields):
- invoice/header/poNumber -> must contain our PO exactly as issued (case insensitive).
- invoice/header/billingEntity/cuit -> CUIT (11 digits, no punctuation).
- invoice/header/totalVAT -> separate VAT line items preferred (IVA 21/10/27 etc.).
- invoice/footer/afipUUID -> AFIP comprobante UUID or CAE references (we use this for audit links).

Acceptable evidence: AFIP XML + CAE is preferred; PDF can be attached but XML is required for automatic validation. For payments to route automatically to PO, the invoice must reference at least one active PO and match billing entity CUIT we have on file.

Operational notes / next steps:
1) Please fill the PO_activation_template_AR.docx we attached and return with a sample XML that has the PO number filled in.
2) If you cannot include CUIT in 11-digit form, send your tax authority extraction and we'll map manually (one-time).
3) Our AP team will run a small validation job once you send the updated XML. Expect 24–48 hours for PO activation after the validated file is received.

I've looped in Karthik for any Argentina-specific withholding or tax flags and Laura to coordinate PO provisioning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick Argentina-specific items to call out (we've seen common pitfalls on this).

Argentina notes:
- CUIT formatting: we ingest CUIT as 11 digits; if you have hyphens/spaces our parser may fail. See CUIT_validation_note.pdf.
- Withholding (Percepciones) and gross income tax: if the invoice includes local withholdings, include separate XML tags for "perceptionTotal" and the withholding agent CUIT. That helps our tax team reconcile with local withholdings.
- Invoice type codes: AFIP uses comprobanteTipo codes (e.g., 01, 03); please keep type in header and attach CAE if available.

PO/Procurement operational exception:
- If Fiskar needs net settlement to a non-AR entity, please indicate in the PO activation template and upload the fiscal agent appointment (if applicable). That triggers manual review and may add 3–5 business days.

Testing plan:
1) Lucas to send revised XML with PO number and stripped CUIT punctuation.
2) We run validation against a staging parser and return a CSV of any mismatched fields.
3) Once validated, Laura will flip PO provisioning to Active for up to 3 POs as a pilot.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk through the XML tags — happy to join.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Onboarding & Tax Integration
Redwood Inference
